name: Regional Government of the Azores
note: Devolved government of the Autonomous Region of the Azores (Portugal). The European Commission's state-aid approval of 7 June 2022 describes the SATA Group (whose airlines include Azores Airlines) as 'ultimately controlled by the Portuguese Autonomous Region of Azores'; the group's own September 2026 privatisation notice (azoresairlines.pt) shows that a sale of at least 75% of Azores Airlines was still running then.
